shape: a small everyday annoyance someone causes now, seen from the day it stops

slides.text: they finally stopped turning the hallway light on for midnight snacks, so the dark finally let me sleep

caption:
the quiet after the switch feels like a soft sigh in the room
i notice the floor tiles more when the bulb stays dark
it’s the little night that lets thoughts drift
send this to the partner who still flips the hallway light on for midnight snacks
